Gemini 2.5 Flash — 800 Images

50/class slice: 72.9% accuracy, per-class table, top confusion pairs, cost projections.

Experiment: google/gemini-2.5-flash — 800 Images (50 per class × 16 classes)

Experiment ID: main-1785272634 Dataset: 2550x3300_50perclass_800/images/ (2550×3300 padded PNGs, 300 DPI) Prompt: CLASSIFICATION_PROMPT from src/openrouter_classifier.py (baseline, pre-disambiguation) Settings: max_tokens=1024, temperature=0.1, reasoning.effort=medium Image size: 2550×3300 Model: google/gemini-2.5-flash via OpenRouter

Key Findings

  • scientific_report is massively over-predicted — 64 false positives from 7 different classes
  • Bottom 3 classes (form 30%, presentation 36%, specification 46%) account for ~50% of all errors
  • Fax cover sheets labeled as form are consistently predicted as memo or letter
  • specification vs scientific_report is the single worst confusion pair (25 errors)
